verdict.rationale: Docs confirm every call produces a transcript and recording (bolna-docs-23, bolna-docs-14), accessible programmatically via API/quickstart and CLI (bolna-docs-16, bolna-docs-24), plus a dashboard call-history view exposing recordings, transcripts and raw execution data (bolna-docs-34). Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of the transcript/recording retrieval endpoints and no explicit OpenAPI spec confirming the exact API schema (bolna-probe-2 shows openapi.json 404).
